frameworks.name: claude-code-reference
frameworks.notes: Configure a real existing CLI that accepts the same model/endpoint. Each argv element is separate; placeholders: {workspace}, {prompt_file}, {model}. Do not label a custom generic loop as Claude Code.

protocol: Freeze dataset and budgets before experiment. Record model and baseline CLI versions. Populate course public questions and second model. Compile using the same CODESYS profile/template. Automatic subset tests are supplementary; runtime validation is separate. Review all self-built questions before submission.
